posts.title: Guitar Amp Modelers Are Dead.
posts.description: Amp modellers are dead. I don't say that lightly or to be hyperbolic. It's just true. NAM-A2 is here and it is awesome.

posts.title: An ESP32 based plane radar
posts.description: Plane radar is a neat little project that pulls nearby ADS-B traffic, plots each aircraft by distance and bearing, and shows the details directly on a cute little screen.

posts.title: After 11 years, I dropped Ghost
posts.description: After nearly eleven years of being continuously served via Ghost, this blog is now a static site built with Astro.
